page.layout: One printed page. A single text column with a page number at the head. Left margin: handwritten marginalia in ink, not printed, so left out. Below the text: the catchword "gi-" at the right.

main_text.p: D. An praemium semel forti viro datum, post alteri forti postulanti concedi propter praemiorum incertam & in-stabilem rationem non oporteat. Exposui de scripti & voluntatis cōparatione: nūc ad contrarie scripta disputationem traducimus, si modò Quintiliani locum insignem ad hoc caput pertinētem, ex libri VII. capite VI. subiecerimus:

„Scripti, inquit Fabius, & voluntatis frequentissima inter Consultos quaestio est, & pars magna controversię iuris hinc pendet: quo minus id in scholis accidere mirum est, ubi etiam ex industria fin-gi-

page.notes: The running head is faint and smeared; I could not read it reliably. The line "non oporteat" ends with "opor" and continues "teat" on the next line with no visible hyphen, so I wrote the word whole as "oporteat". The Roman numeral is printed "VI I." with a space; I read it as VII. The left margin marks are handwriting and were excluded. The text ends at "fin"; the catchword "gi-" is printed below the last line.
